_about: adapter_config.json (a PEFT LoRA adapter) as a declaration file: every key it can carry, what a consumer loses when it does not read the key, and which keys each supported consumer reads (code lines as evidence; ROADMAP M17.1). The rule is one and lives in adapter_config_contract.py: a key declared with a value that changes how the adapter's weights apply, that this consumer does not read, is a dropped declaration - resolved where the adapter can carry it into the consumer, broken (reported) where it cannot. A key declared with its neutral value (the default, under which not reading it changes nothing), a key the weights themselves carry (which modules exist), and a training-time key decide nothing. A key entail does not know is said once as unknown when its value is not empty. Keys are PEFT 0.21.0 LoraConfig fields (peft/tuners/lora/config.py).

r.about: the rank; the weights' shapes carry it

lora_alpha.about: the scale numerator; every consumer reads it

target_modules.about: which modules the adapter has weights for; the weights carry it

use_rslora.effect: the adapter is scaled by lora_alpha / r instead of lora_alpha / sqrt(r): sqrt(r) times too weak (4x at r=16, 8x at r=64)

use_dora.effect: DoRA's magnitude vectors are not applied: the adapter runs as a plain LoRA

rank_pattern.effect: modules with their own rank are scaled by the adapter-wide lora_alpha / r instead of their own

alpha_pattern.effect: modules with their own alpha are scaled by the adapter-wide alpha instead of their own

lora_bias.effect: the trained bias on lora_B is not applied

bias.effect: the base model's trained biases that the adapter ships are not applied

modules_to_save.effect: the fully trained modules the adapter ships (a classifier head, embeddings) are not applied

fan_in_fan_out.effect: the adapter's weights are stored transposed (Conv1D bases) and are applied in the wrong orientation

target_parameters.effect: the adapter targets parameters (MoE expert tensors) and those weights are not applied

trainable_token_indices.effect: the trained token-embedding rows are not applied

alora_invocation_tokens.effect: an activated LoRA is applied to every position instead of after its invocation tokens

use_qalora.effect: QALoRA's grouped forward for quantized bases is not applied

qalora_group_size.effect: QALoRA's group size is not applied

use_bdlora.effect: the BD-LoRA forward is not applied

layer_replication.effect: the base model's layers are not replicated as the adapter was trained on

ensure_weight_tying.effect: tied embeddings the adapter expects to stay tied may come apart

exclude_modules.about: narrows the targets; the weights that exist say which

layers_to_transform.about: which layers; the weights that exist say which

base_model_name_or_path.about: which base it was trained on: load.lora notes it

arrow_config.effect: Arrow routing among adapters is not applied

kasa_config.effect: the KaSA variant's forward is not applied

monteclora_config.effect: the MonteCLoRA variant's forward is not applied

velora_config.effect: the VeLoRA variant's forward is not applied
